population: final adapted COMET prescribing cohort from Track 1; provisional feasibility uses prior 6530-person roster

primary_candidate.event_rule: first validated death date strictly after index and on or before horizon/admin end
primary_candidate.estimand: initiation-based treatment-policy analogue; exact effect scale pending final analysis contract

why_this_calendar_rule: Death counts are stable by month through 2024; 2025 becomes visibly incomplete in March and nearly absent in April. Full-year 2024 is a conservative observed boundary, conditional on source provenance.
mandatory_gates: Confirm DEATH_DATE provenance, linkage, update lag, and completeness through 2024-12-31.
Resolve or exclude with structured reason the one provisional patient/index whose death precedes index.
Rerun pooled and arm-level calendar attrition on Track 1 final patient/index manifest.
Do not classify missing DEATH_DATE as survival unless completeness through the administrative end is validated.
Freeze estimand, effect scale, same-day policy, and analysis-stage imputation interface before outcome estimation.

requirements: Apply the mortality coverage gate above.
